text:
I am very grateful to have had Dr. Kawin (aka Dr. KK) at Karin Dental Clinic as my dentist for many years now.

He and his staff are professional, competent and friendly. Dr. KK speaks English well and is generous with his time, explaining things to me simply (and even with pictures sometimes!) so that I can understand them.

His office is well equipped, and they even produce crowns for their dental practice and other practices, so that crown replacements can be done in a day or two instead of the week it used to take.

Communicating with the office in writing online works well too.

Special thanks to them for spending a lot of time helping me file and appeal a tedious claim with my US dental insurance company a few years ago.

Bonus: There is a Mixue ice cream store just a few steps away! :)

text:
2 months ago I reached out to Karin Dental to get a quote to extract my wisdom teeth, it was after-hours so I didn't expect a response until the following day however almost immediately someone was talking to me and answering all my questions. Not only that, but when I sent an x-ray I had gotten done previously they took the time to draw on it and explain each tooth and the cost to me. It was honestly such amazing service and the price quoted to extract all 4 of my wisdom teeth I believe was very good.

Unfortunately I never got to go to this dentist because my partner got severe /life-threatening dengue fever and we had to return home.

But for 2 months this experience has stayed with me and I am so grateful to now finally share a review.  Should we ever return to Thailand I would not hesitate to fly directly to Chiang Mai just so I could visit this dentist.

Thank you so much for your service :)

Sarah 🌻

text: I was unimpressed with the doctor's demeanor and words. Even after the assessment, they couldn't pinpoint exactly what needed fixing. Their expression seemed disgusted by the appearance of my teeth. I've consulted with several other doctors who are already accustomed to seeing my teeth. Veneers might be affordable for some, but for many, the cost could buy a used car or cover several semesters of school fees, so price is a crucial consideration. (However, the service from the counter staff was excellent.) Some patients may have a budget in mind or no limitations, but everyone expects a final price that's final. If they can't explain the cost, they should have someone who can. Simply quoting a price of around 200,000-300,000 baht seemed uncaring, as if they didn't care if the patient couldn't afford it. Everyone should know the approximate price before a consultation. Pros: Clean clinic, parking available, and their own lab.
